episodes.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
episodes.summary: The child of immigrants, young Scorsese is shaped by the Catholic Church and the violent streets around him, with cinema as his escape.

episodes.title: All This Filming Isn't Healthy
episodes.summary: Scorsese partners with Robert De Niro and becomes a definitive cinematic voice of the 1970s — while personal struggles bring him to the brink.

episodes.title: Saint/Sinner
episodes.summary: After a rebirth with Raging Bull and then a flop with The King of Comedy, Scorsese learns to work small again and pursues a passion project.

episodes.title: Total Cinema
episodes.summary: Following a turbulent period of international controversy, Scorsese achieves massive success and a new vision of cinema in Goodfellas.

episodes.title: Method Director
episodes.summary: As a partnership with Leonardo DiCaprio brings Scorsese's career to new heights, he continues to reinvent himself as a filmmaker and a man.
